rows.abstract: Adds  the following paragraph  to Section 137 of the Corporation Code of the Philippines:  "SECTION 137-A. UNRESTRICTED RETAINED EARNINGS DEFINED.  - THE      TERM "UNRESTRICTED RETAINED EARN- INGS",  AS USED IN THIS CODE,  MEANS THE  NET ACCUMULATED REALIZED EARN-     INGS OF  THE CORPORATION, NOT  RE- SERVED  OR SET ASIDE BY IT  FOR  A CORPORATE PURPOSE OR PURSUANT TO  A LEGAL  OR CONTRACTUAL REQUIREMENT CALLED  FOR OR  ARISING FROM   ITS BUSINESS  OR INTRA  VIRES TRANSAC- TIONS, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO      GAINS FROM SALES OR ITS  FIXED AS-     SETS, TREASURY SHARES  AND OTHER PROPERTY." * * *
